headline: 蜘蛛侠持续霸榜，暑期档热度不减
headlineEn: Spider-Man keeps topping charts as summer heat continues
summary: 今日无新片上映，本周三部新片入市。蜘蛛侠：崭新之日稳居热搜首位，特别行动：母狮、奥德赛等话题升温，影市热度延续。
summaryEn: No new releases today, with three new films opening this week. Spider-Man: A Brand New Day tops trends, while Special Ops: Lioness and Odyssey gain buzz.

industryHighlights.text: 今日新片上映数为零，进入暑期档短暂空档
industryHighlights.en: Zero new releases today, a brief summer slate gap

industryHighlights.text: 本周三部新片开画，市场供给保持节奏
industryHighlights.en: Three new films opened this week, keeping release momentum

industryHighlights.text: 《超级少女》《揭秘日》等跻身周趋势榜，题材多元
industryHighlights.en: Supergirl and Reveal Day join weekly trends, showing diverse genres

industryHighlights.text: 待映新作包括《The Last Sunrise》《OK老板娘2》《逃出绝命街》
